description: Make a link to our website's basket with these appliances already in it: new items by model number, and/or specific graded units by graded_id (at their graded price). The customer opens it, enters their address, chooses a delivery date and pays on our site. Nothing is ordered or paid until the customer does that. For graded units you must first show the customer the grade and condition notes and offer the photos (get_graded_photos), then set condition_shown_to_customer.

condition_shown_to_customer.description: Required true when graded_ids is used: the customer has seen each graded unit's grade and condition notes and been offered the photos

graded_ids.description: graded_id of specific GRADED units (from get_product graded_options)

models.description: Model numbers of NEW items to put in the basket

name: basket_link
title: Make a basket link
